s1.syndrome_frame: Facial asymmetry with possible cranial nerve involvement in a neonate
salient_findings: Enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal on MRI
Profound hearing loss in the left ear on ABR testing
key_facts: 4-week-old male patient
Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
Passed infant hearing screening
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Ki-67 labeling index: 5% to 10%
CD34 and CD31 positive for endothelial cells

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed an enhancing mass, histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion

shortlist.label: Lymphangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination showed a biphasic lesion with vascular nodules, similar to lymphangiomatosis

shortlist.label: Lymphangiomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination revealed a pattern similar to lymphangiomatosis

shortlist.label: Cavernous hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed an enhancing mass, histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Glomus tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination revealed a glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules
